question: The Khilafat Movement originated in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Turkey.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Khilafat Movement is also known as the Caliphate moment.
 
• The Khilafat Movement (1919–1924) or the Indian Muslim Movement, was a pan-Islamist political protest campaign started by the Muslims of British India.

 
• The movement was led by the Ali brothers (Mohammad Ali and Shaukat Ali)

Cause of originating Caliphat moment

 
• Alliance of Turkey and British:- Muslims of the world including India considered the Sultan of Turkey as their spiritual leader (Calipha).

 
 
• During the First World War, Turkey allied with Germany and Austria against the British.
 
• Indian Muslims supported the British in the First World War with the hope that the British would give the holy throne of the Ottoman Empire to the Calipha.
 
• After the First World War Ottoman Empire was divided, and Turkey was separated from the Caliphate.
 
• This angered the Muslims who considered it an insult to the Calipha.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Khilafat Committee

 
• The All India Khilafat Committee was formed in 1919 under the leadership of the Ali brothers, Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, Ajmal Khan, and Hasrat Mohani, to force the British government to change its attitude towards Turkey.
 
• All India Khilafat Committee was organized in Delhi in November 1919 and foreign goods were boycotted.
